entry.title: Updated: dsh-remote
entry.summary: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab and auto-fills `/` for remote paths, live-completing each directory level. Exact install spec: dsh-remote. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
